Advertisement
Chhattisgarh State Electricity Regulatory Commission (CSERC) has announced
vacancies for one (01) post of Member and one (01) post of Member (Law). The Government
of Chhattisgarh, Department of Energy is inviting applications from qualified eligible
candidates for above said two (02) positions.
1/ Qualification :
Section 84 of The Electricity Act, 2003 stipulates the qualification of a person
for being eligible for the selection of the Member and Member (Law) posl which is
as follows :-
(1.1) The Members of the State Commission shall be persons of ability, integrity and
standing who have adequate knowledge of, and have shown capacity in, dealing
with problems relating to engineering, finance, commerce, economics, law or
management.
(1.2) The Member of the State Commission shall not hold any other office.
Additional and essential requirement for Member (Law) :
A person who is or has been holding a post of High Court Judge or District
Judge or possessing requisite qualification to have been appointed as a judge of High
Court or a District Judge.
2/ Tenure :- As per section 89 of the Electricity Act, 2003 The Members so appointed
shall hold the post for a term of 5 years from the date on which he/she enters upon
officer or till he/she attains the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
3/ Pay :- The Members shall be entitled to pay level of 15 of 7th pay scale notified by
Government of India plus other allowance as notified by State Government.
If the incumbent draws pension, then he/she will be entitled to get the pay after
deduction of the pension amount. The person so appointed shall not hold any other
office. He/she shall have to resign or opt for voluntary retirement aom the existing
service, if any, to which he belongs, in case he has not attained the age of
superannuation.
4/ Other terms and conditions of the service would be as provided in the Electricity Act,
2003
5/ How to apply -
